up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5233229'. For each distinct molecule, provide: its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). To associate molecules with the document, join the docs table (filtered by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5233229') to compound_records via doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary via molregno, and finally to compound_structures via molregno. Return distinct rows for each molecule.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5233229';
